title: Transcription
intro: Turns what is said during a session into text, filed under each round-table turn, for the minutes and the AI assistant. Each meeting allows it in its own settings.
urlHint: Leave empty for OpenAI. A self-hosted Whisper server (faster-whisper-server, speaches…) works too: its address ends with /v1.
modelHint: whisper-1 or gpt-4o-transcribe with OpenAI; the model name of your server otherwise.
keyHint: Needed for OpenAI; optional for a self-hosted server. Stored encrypted.
keySaved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
privacy: The sound of a recorded session is sent to this service in pieces of thirty seconds, then deleted: only the text stays, with the session.
